plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Theatre Design and Production (BFA) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Theatre Design & Production Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Design & Production (Campus)', last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026 (the workbook Index lists Online as N/A for this program). Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. The catalog prints 'Total Credits, BFA Degree: 120', which the map matches exactly (16/15/15/14/16/16/15/13). The catalog reconciles exactly and the map exercises it in full: BFA Theatre Core Requirements 31 (THEA 4890 Internship recorded at 3, the minimum of its catalog 3-12 credit range, as the map places it) and Design & Production Requirements 59, comprising Design & Production Requirements proper 37 (including THEA 3545 Production Practicum at 1 credit in each of four terms, per the catalog's 'must take 4 semesters'; allow_repeated_courses), Advanced Production Coursework 6 (two map slots), Advanced Concentration Coursework 6 (two map slots the map labels 'Advanced Design Course'), Capstone 3 (one slot, which exercises the catalog's Capstone Pathway: Pathway A - THEA 4751 Capstone (3 credits); or Pathway B - THEA 4752 Production Practicum Capstone (2 credits) AND THEA 4761 Production Capstone Symposium (1 credit), 3 credits in total.), and Support Courses 7 (three map slots of 3, 3, and 1 credits). Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates (THEA 1033, THEA 2533, THEA 2632, THEA 3723).
